text: On a snowy night a stranger, [his face swathed in bandages and dark goggles|images|wounded and changing bodies], takes a room at an inn in the Sussex village of Iping and demands to be left alone. He is Dr. Jack Griffin, a chemist made invisible by a drug called monocaine, which [has quietly driven him mad|origin|a mind turning on itself]. Laughing, he sheds his clothes and vanishes, then plans [a reign of terror to dominate the world|wants|power over others], while his fiancée Flora watches him slip beyond reach.
